operations.sql:
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_medicines_fulltext 
            ON medicines USING GIN(to_tsvector('simple', 
              COALESCE(name, '') || ' ' || 
              COALESCE(chinese_name, '') || ' ' || 
              COALESCE(english_name, '') || ' ' || 
              COALESCE(pinyin_name, '')
            )) WHERE status = 'active';

operations.name: optimize_sku_index
operations.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_medicines_sku_unique 
            ON medicines(sku) WHERE status = 'active';

operations.name: verify_indexes
operations.sql:
SELECT indexname, indexdef 
            FROM pg_indexes 
            WHERE tablename = 'medicines' 
            AND indexname LIKE 'idx_medicines_%'
            ORDER BY indexname;
